competitorChecks.finding: Good search/filter/GIF gallery, but stale at 327 rows and missing 20 Trello rows.

competitorChecks.label: RobloxDen emotes guide
competitorChecks.finding: Useful as an old competitor guide, but not a data source because it only says over 90 emotes.

notes: Direct Trello row count is canonical for this dataset because it exposes 347 open cards in the four emote lists and was last active on 2026-05-24.

JJSBuilder is missing these 20 direct Trello rows: are you, Aura Monster, Awkward, Brainrot, Cooking Granny, Dead Wrong, Ex Provocation, Excuse me sir, Homelander, how tze was moving, Lost Media, Provocation, Reclassed, Saiyan Walk, simply walk around it, Superstar1, Superstar2, Superstar3, Tomodachi, VESSELLL.
The Trello information card still says Total Number of Emotes: 345, but the actual open emote card count is 347 and matches the current Fandom reported total.
Gifting remains unresolved because JJSBuilder says emotes cannot be gifted while Fandom visible text says emotes can be gifted; final public copy avoids gifting claims.
No local images were prepared because available preview media is mostly animated GIF/video and the approved V1 policy requires clean local static WebP stills only.
